summary: Iteration 2 (bundles + tiers + reviews) fully verified. 47/47 backend pytest cases pass (30 iter-1 regressions + 17 iter-2 new). All new UI flows work end-to-end: 4 BundleCards on marketplace with SAVE% badges, TierBadge on every ToolCard with speed, Why-panel + reviews section on tool detail, star+comment+submit posts review and appears in list, logged-out shows 'Sign in to leave a review', bundle→cart→Stripe checkout redirect confirmed on the real hosted URL (US$129.00 'Growth Engine' line item). Admin dashboard Recent Transactions correctly shows bundle purchases as separate rows (Growth Engine $129, Creator Pack $99).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 646 lines. Approaching the 700-line split threshold; recommend refactoring into routers/ (auth.py, catalog.py, reviews.py, bundles.py, payments.py, admin.py, ai.py) before iteration 3 adds more surface area.

GET /api/tools/{slug}/reviews does NOT 404 on an unknown slug — it silently returns {reviews:[], average:0, count:0}. Test accepts either. Consider validating slug against catalog for a cleaner 404, mirroring POST behavior.

seed_reviews() only runs when the reviews collection is empty. Any manual edit to SAMPLE_REVIEWS won't be picked up on redeploy unless the collection is truncated. Consider a lightweight upsert-by-(slug,user_name) or an env flag to force reseed.

In reviews GET response, review docs include user_id which is fine but expose internal ids to any anonymous client. Consider dropping user_id from public reviews or replacing with a stable public display id — low risk, low priority.
Bundle icon 'Rocket' (founders-toolkit) — verify icons.jsx maps it; the marketplace screenshot shows a fallback square. Not a functional bug but a cosmetic miss.
CORS still uses allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True — recommended to whitelist FRONTEND_URL for production hardening (carryover from iter-1).
test_credentials: Admin: admin@aitoolemporium.com / Emporium@2026. Fresh users registered dynamically via /register (TEST_ prefixed emails).
seed_data_creation: Two temporary paid payment_transactions docs inserted directly into MongoDB inside two tests (TestLibraryBundleExpansion, TestVerifiedReview) to simulate paid-bundle state without going through Stripe hosted checkout. Both tests clean up (delete users + txns + sessions + reviews) on teardown. Real Stripe test sessions (cs_test_...) created for two checkout tests remain in payment_transactions in 'initiated/pending' status — same pattern as iteration 1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py and reuses the iter-1 suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Both run via `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/ -v` in ~16s (pytest-xdist, 2 workers). The library-expansion + verified-review tests require MONGO_URL/DB_NAME so the test file calls load_dotenv on /app/backend/.env — do not remove that. Every new endpoint from the review request is covered: GET/POST /api/bundles(+/{slug}), tier/speed/why enrichment, reviews CRUD + auth + upsert + verified flag, bundle checkout persistence (is_bundle + included_slugs), and library bundle expansion into 3 individual tools. Frontend verified flows: marketplace bundles-section renders all 4 BundleCards with SAVE% badges; add-bundle-<slug> increments cart-count and toggles to 'IN CART'; ToolCard shows TierBadge + speed; tool-detail why-panel has Tier/Speed/Quality columns + why text; reviews-section renders seeded reviews with Verified badges and average; logged-out shows 'Sign in' prompt (no submit-review button); logged-in user can star-<n> + review-comment + submit-review and their review appears immediately in the list; cart → checkout-btn redirects to real checkout.stripe.com hosted URL for a bundle line item. Admin recent-transactions correctly shows bundle line items (Growth Engine $129 / Creator Pack $99).
verified_flows_iter2: GET /api/bundles -> 4 bundles (creator-pack, growth-engine, founders-toolkit, career-launch); each has lookup_key=bundle_<slug>, savings_pct, and tools array.
GET /api/bundles/creator-pack -> full detail incl. tool taglines; unknown slug -> 404.
GET /api/tools + /api/tools/{slug} include tier / speed / quality_tier / why for every tool. neurocopy -> Gold / Fast / Best-in-class.

POST /api/tools/neurocopy/reviews unauth -> 401; rating=9 -> 422; unknown slug -> 404; new user post -> verified=false; second post by same user upserts (list count unchanged, comment/rating updated).
POST /api/tools/storyforge/reviews after inserting a paid bundle txn -> verified=true (bundle included_slugs lookup works).

POST /api/payments/checkout with lookup_key=bundle_creator-pack -> Stripe cs_test_ session; payment_transactions item stored with is_bundle=true and included_slugs=[storyforge,socialpulse,emailgenie]. Verified via /payments/status.
GET /api/library after simulated paid bundle expands into 3 owned tools (storyforge+socialpulse+emailgenie).
Frontend Marketplace: bundles-section renders 4 BundleCards with SAVE% badge; add-bundle-<slug> increments cart-count; button flips to 'IN CART'.
Frontend ToolCard: tier-<Tier> badge + speed rendered on every card (18 badges across marketplace).
Frontend ToolDetail (neurocopy): why-panel with Tier/Speed/Quality + why text; reviews-section shows 2 seeded reviews with Verified badges; logged-out user sees 'Sign in to leave a review'.
Frontend ToolDetail logged-in: star-4 click + review-comment fill + submit-review -> new review appears in the review-item list (count 2 -> 3, avg updates).
Frontend Cart: adding bundle-growth-engine then /cart shows the bundle line; checkout-btn redirects to real checkout.stripe.com hosted URL for US$129.00 'Growth Engine'.
Frontend Home: hero-logo (logo-mark.png) and navbar logo (logo-full.png) load correctly.

Frontend Admin (admin@aitoolemporium.com): /admin renders Command Center + Revenue Signal chart + Recent Transactions table containing the new bundle rows (Growth Engine $129, Creator Pack $99) with status pending.
